sections.question: How far below its end-of-2024 peak, in millions of dollars, was Microchip's inventory balance at the close of its first quarter of fiscal 2027?
sections.reasoning:
Step 1 (Doc 5): Microchip's release for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 quotes its CFO: "From the high point at the end of December 2024, we have now reduced the inventory by $320.9 million." Its balance sheet shows inventories of 1,035.4 at March 31, 2026, the date that "now" refers to. End-of-2024 peak: 1,035.4 + 320.9 = 1,356.3.

Step 2 (Doc 6): The first quarter of fiscal year 2027 is the three months ended June 30, 2026. The balance sheet shows inventories of 1,047.3 at June 30, 2026, up from 1,035.4 at the prior quarter-end.

Step 3 (Doc 5 and Doc 6): 1,356.3 - 1,047.3 = 309.0 ($ millions).

The 320.9 in Doc 5 is the reduction up to March 31, 2026, not up to June 30, 2026.
